HTTPS enforcement is now confirmed enabled by the Pages API (`https_enforced: true`, `html_url: https://pixelelated.com/`). This resolves the remaining owner-setting item in the previous publication handoff.

HTTP apex, HTTP/HTTPS www, and the github.io alias all finish on the intended HTTPS apex page. The github.io homepage alias still returned the earlier HTTP intermediate hop in this readback, followed immediately by the enforced HTTPS redirect; its guide aliases redirected straight to HTTPS. All final destinations are correct. The custom-domain HTTPS www redirects stay on HTTPS throughout.

No source rebuild is needed: the deployed build already uses HTTPS canonical and asset URLs. The website preview is ready for experimentation. Firmware QR integration remains separate work; no firmware or DNS records were changed.

The owner wants the website design language to draw from the developing pixelelated logo/palette work and lore/story explorations, with a mood board available as further input. [Draft website PR #3](https://github.com/pixelelated/website/pull/3) records that direction in [the design brief](https://github.com/pixelelated/website/blob/70f0d636180782be8aa2418ac03d545cda36b936/docs/design-language.md).

The draft uses the canonical interim Tiny5 Duo LCD system and six approved palette treatments at distribution `0fc5a41e9960661a4f2047df5fcc4a6b918e6ee4`; Ocean remains the existing default. Website typography, supporting surfaces, component styling, and artwork placement are proposed choices, not settled brand decisions. The current dark preview is a baseline for comparison.

Next visual round: review the latest logo exercises, story references, and mood board; compare two or three small samples using the same homepage/guide content; then develop one homepage and one complete guide prototype. Lore-specific imagery and character roles remain open until those references are available. No matching lore material was found in the scoped repository and issue searches, which does not establish its absence elsewhere.

This is an internal documentation draft; no live styling or firmware work changed. The source references and staged whitespace check passed. Website design remains independent of firmware release gates.

The owner supplied the missing art and world references. They have now been reviewed, and [private website draft PR #3](https://github.com/pixelelated/website/pull/3) has been updated with source-linked design direction and two concrete composition studies. This supersedes the earlier note that story references were still missing.

The detailed findings and approval distinctions remain in the private website brief. Reference material was not copied into the public site. This update changes internal planning prose only; staged whitespace validation passed. The draft remains open for design exploration, with no change to live styling, artist assignments, or firmware priorities.
